output_text:
```python
from google.cloud import documentai_v1 as documentai
import io
import os

def extract_invoice_info(file_path):
    project_id = "YOUR_PROJECT_ID"
    location = "us"
    processor_id = "YOUR_PROCESSOR_ID"  # Set your processor ID here

    client_options = {"api_endpoint": f"{location}-documentai.googleapis.com"}
    client = documentai.DocumentProcessorServiceClient(client_options=client_options)

    with open(file_path, "rb") as image:
        image_content = image.read()

    image = documentai.RawDocument(content=image_content)
    request = documentai.ProcessRequest(
        name=f"projects/{project_id}/locations/{location}/processors/{processor_id}",
        raw_document=image,
    )

    result = client.process_document(request=request)
    document = result.document

    vendor = document.entities[0].text if document.entities else "Unknown"
    date = document.entities[1].text if len(document.entities) > 1 else "Unknown"
    total = document.entities[2].text if len(document.entities) > 2 else "Unknown"

    line_items = []
    for entity in document.entities:
        if entity.type_ == "LINE_ITEM":
            line_items.append(entity.text)

    return {
        "vendor": vendor,
        "date": date,
        "total": total,
        "line_items": line_items,
    }
```
